nodes.title: Protocol Ingestion
nodes.desc: Document AI parses protocol → extracts requirements, geo, therapeutic area

nodes.title: Geospatial Grounding
nodes.desc: Define country mix, patient radius, geographic rules. Lives on SCENARIO.

nodes.title: Hard Filter Application
nodes.desc: Match protocol requirements to site capabilities (freezer, imaging, lab certs)

nodes.title: Scoring & Weighting
nodes.desc: Apply velocity/enrollment/engagement weights. Future: customer-defined bucket

nodes.title: Scenario Creation
nodes.desc: Create/clone/edit scenarios. Each is a named collection of sites with weights

nodes.title: Feasibility Assessment
nodes.desc: Send questionnaire to selected sites. 2-week runway. Pre-fill from history.

nodes.title: Workflow Approval
nodes.desc: Approve scenario for feasibility send. Re-approval needed after edits.

nodes.title: Rescore from Results
nodes.desc: Feasibility results feed back. Site scored 7 might drop to 3. Track reasons.

nodes.title: Site Exclusion/Inclusion
nodes.desc: Exclude sites with tracked reasons. Can re-include later. History preserved.

edges.label: extracts requirements
edges.desc: AI fuzzy-matches protocol text to existing filter fields

edges.label: chosen scenario
edges.desc: Only the selected scenario goes to feasibility

edges.label: needs approval
edges.desc: Workflow approval required before feasibility send

edges.label: results return
edges.desc: ~2 weeks. Answers populate fields on site record.

edges.label: triggers exclusion
edges.desc: e.g., freezer broke → exclude with reason

edges.label: feeds back
edges.desc: New scores may warrant new/cloned scenario

edges.label: adjust scenario
edges.desc: Excluded sites removed; can be re-included with reason

questions.text: Where does geospatial grounding live — on Study or Scenario?
questions.notes: Lorie argues Scenario (8/14): changing geo on study loses history. Jacqueline initially thought Study but agreed with Lorie's rationale.

questions.text: How do new filter fields get created when protocol has novel requirements?
questions.notes: Multi-step: protocol ingestion → identify net-new requirement → create field on HCF/Investigator → add to criteria-based search. Could be Flow-automated.

questions.text: What are the limits on criteria-based search & filter UI with 90+ requirements?
questions.notes: Lorie investigating. Too many filters = unusable scrolling. Need collapsible categories. Not fixable in OOTB component — would need custom UI.

questions.text: Can Document AI handle 35-233 page protocols with intelligent chunking?
questions.notes: Testing needed. Data Libraries does header-based chunking but may not be sufficient. Both Lorie and Jacqueline testing independently.

questions.text: What does the workflow approval process look like for scenarios?
questions.notes: Not every scenario needs approval — only the one chosen for feasibility. Editing approved scenario requires re-approval.

questions.text: How do feasibility answers get stored and pre-filled for future studies?
questions.notes: Stored on site/investigator record historically. Pre-fill from prior answers. Confirms things that may have changed.

questions.text: Should scoring weights be hardcoded or customer-configurable?
questions.notes: Current: 3 fixed (velocity, enrollment, engagement). Future: larger bucket, customer picks their own. Needs AI/formula scoring mechanism.

questions.text: How does the skip logic work when cloning a scenario?
questions.notes: Lorie: clone gets a "tick" that lets you skip earlier steps and go directly to the piece you want to change. Stage management rules.

questions.text: What is the handoff model from demo → product (Charmaine)?
questions.notes: Show visionary version + "here's what we recommend next." Product makes final calls. They know platform tricks we may not.

questions.text: How should engagement profile / site satisfaction factor into selection?
questions.notes: Soft factors: were they responsive? problematic? Sites hate redundant questions. CROs want to be "swiped right." Sentiment early triggers.
